provider_competence.support_unit: scheduled identity with claim-bearing triangulations at both birth and update
provider_competence.primary_error: coordinate RMSE at the registered update
provider_competence.late_error: coordinate RMSE over the final five frames ending at each registered update
provider_competence.persistence_comparator: the provider's own claim-bearing birth triangulation held fixed
provider_competence.shared_bias_covariance: local covariance plus the squared registered shared-bias scale times I

calibration.finite_sample_rule: maximum within-object score over the other seven source objects
calibration.coverage_unit: supported identity at a registered update

assimilation.identity_boundary: exclude every material identity used by any query birth from every future metric
assimilation.regret_target: maximum of candidate-minus-selected-backbone interval identity RMSE and symmetric Chamfer

cross_fitting.method: four deterministic contiguous leave-two-source-object folds in locked source order
cross_fitting.acceptance: strictly negative upper regret; otherwise bit-exact selected-backbone fallback

aggregation.technical_failure_contribution: zero improvement and no win; never replaced
